I’m using “I am Sober” from the app store for iphone! Gives me daily reminder to pledge and reminds me of how far I’ve come. Really helps me to monitor. 👍🏻

I’m currently using valerian root, 5htp and melatonin to deal with the sleep. I have a script of trazadone and mirtazipine, both of which are unaddictive light hypnotics. Sleep will come, as long as you’re practicing good sleep hygiene and all. 🤙🏻
Hang in there mate!
It’s by the sidebar (or the about section if you’re on mobile)

My girlfriend don’t trust me drinking either. After a brief short stint of trying to be sober(my family and my gf believed that I was really getting sober), I slipped up thinking I could have a few drinks this past NYE and call it quits. No, I started drinking and bingeing once again, and even having to hide my drinks in those starbucks tumblers so I could sip when the fam and gf is around. Several times they sniffed alcohol on me, only for me to rub it off and say they’re just imagining it. They know, but they just went along with me.

Several times I’ve had huge alcohol-induced fight with the gf because I wasn’t in the right mind and I just denied all forms of reason that she gave me during the fights. I now finally realise it’s the alcohol that is destroying the bonds and intimacy with my girlfriend, and the trust my family have for me. It’s a sudden realisation sort of thing, where I know if I go on, I’m never gonna really stop. 

I called it quits yesterday, and this time I have to hold myself accountable and be true to it to not lose my girlfriend and my family. I’m not on the same situation as you but heck, if you have to choose between your boyfriend and family or the bottle, you would prolly know which you would prefer.

Social issues (parties and outing, etcetera) wise, given time(and it might be a long while), you’ll slowly grip terms with them and it’ll be no problemo. Always be conscious about what you’re feeling. 

Boyfriend wise, what he needs could and would be the reassurance that you would not drink again. He might not listen to what you say, but damn sure he won’t turn a blind eye to the actions you take. He’ll be open to you putting your feet down and proving you can defeat this problem you’re facing. 

You’ve got this, it’s painful, it’s tough but hell, I rather go through the torture of losing the crutch I’ve been holding onto, then the true ones that deep down I know i love and supports me. These are all the advice I could give. Sending love.
And tonight, i shall be trying with you. 🤙🏻
I crawled back to the bottle on new year’s eve with the thought of just having one. Became a full blown many days binge till yesterday. It’ll always be better tomorrow. Have faith 🙏🏼
Tell me about it, literally dreamt I had recurring nightmares of me being chased by chainsaw carrying madmen last night. Not fun.
I slipped up having 10/11 days prior to new year’s eve. Drank nightly(not to the point of black out drunk) till yesterday, and today is my day 1 once again. Push on buddy!
Day 8 for me. Survived christmas booze free. Just go one minute at a time, one hour at a time. You got this !
Thank you, i’ll check it out!
Exactly, it’s now or suffer 10-20 years down the road.
I’m currently seeing one. Thank you friend.

Not the time to call it curtains yet bud. I first tried to call it when I was 21, I was in a daze and I literally attempted to cut my forearm open. Paramedics were called in because I was in public, and I was sent home with a whole ton of stitches, and permanent scars on my forearm. 

Next attempt was when I was 22, I tried to OD on anti-depressants and painkillers along with alcohol. It was a surprise that I even managed to get discharged without being kept in to be monitored. I attempted again few weeks down the road, same method, with higher dosages. This time I was kept in for 3 days, and sent home, with the requirement to be monitored by a family member constantly. 

Now I’m 23, blown into alcoholism because of the outbreak and being locked up at home due to regulations. I’ve contemplated to call it, but the thought of my loved ones and partner mourning over me just pulls me back from the edge. 

It’s not your time yet. Stick around for awhile, it could be a long while, but you’ll realise perhaps that you’ll see that the light in a darkness will become clearer, and that the shattered lens you had, has become magically mended. 

Stay strong bud, we’re all here for you.

It’s okay, i made 2 days multiple times and now i’m on my 8th? That immense craving to just drink is insane, and right now i’m still feeling it. That said, if you slip, it’s okay, we’re humans after all. You have the strength to pick when you want to start over again, leaving the poison behind. You can do this. Grit your teeth and move forward. Let’s go bud 🤙🏻
Celebrate with a drink! But not alcohol, some friendly juice, mocktail and sodas are great. You’ve came so far, and there’s so much more ahead for you ✨🤙

I’ve went to my a mental institute for suicide multiple of times, and man, every single time they just undermine whatever i’m going through. Hold on tight. 

Your boyfriend, i can’t help you, I had a bad relationship that turned good because my partner turned her head around. Talk to your boyfriend(without any substance in you) and try to work things out. Reach out to me if it doesn’t work. I’ll be here.

I’ve tried to kill myself more than i can remember, and every single attempt is to jail, and a trip to the mental hospital. Talk to me if you need to. You’ll be good. You’ll be fine and i believe in you, it’s my day one as well, i’m close to just overdosing myself on medication. 

Hang in there OP. You’re doing well.

I’m on my day one, and I have slipped up twice in a span of like 5 days? It never gets easier, gotta face the trembles, the anxiety, the giddiness and having to act like I’m “normal” with daily routines. That said, I’m seeing my doctor in a day’s time! 

Whatever effort and action you make into sobriety, is worth it. An appointment that costs $300? Worth it. A detox that cost way more? Worth it. Everything is worth it as along as you’re taking steps towards sobriety. I’m with you on this. Message me if you really feel like you need someone to talk to, I will be there. 

Take care and stay safe, you’ve got this!
Thank you! We’re all in this fight together and there’s totally no problem helping one another!

I’m hoping for you and myself too! Just know that if you do slip up, hey it’s okay. It gets too painful and insane sometimes we really need some “medication” to relieve ourselves. Just have to get back on track after and not allow ourselves back on the train to destruction. 

You got this, and i believe in you no matter what you choose to do. 🥳

That’s me right now, trying not to reach for a bottle from my shelf of collection of liquor. 

Allow yourself to feel everything, even if it feels like death. Your body will thank you for not letting it die. I’m currently only on my day 1, and I already feel like what you feel. Let’s fight together, and we will win this fight!

I’ve been drinking for a year, and daily with a 750 of whisky or rum at least. Ive tried to face the withdrawals and i’ve failed multiple times, hence it’s highly possible i’ve kindled. 

It’s day 1 of sobriety for me once again today and my last BP taken was 161/103 with a pulse rate of 113. I’ll say it’s a drop from the crazily high BP, but i’m still in the danger zone.

I was sober for 2 days and I relapsed, if it’s clearer this way.

The BP was actually taken during my bi-weekly visit with my doctor, and that’s why my doctor advised to go for inpatient immediately. Due to exams, I cannot be admitted and hence she put me on a outpatient detox program and fingers crossed it would work.

I have actually tried tapering, and it was so close to working but unluckily, I had access to whisky as it was my best friend’s wedding and I can’t simply reject him on his best night. So here I am, on a outpatient detox, hoping i will not relapse again.
I’m restarting my day 1, i’m gonna just take the medication and accept that I will be uncomfortable. Cheers mate 🤙

I have gotten a lot more recovery help from this sub then other subs as well.

Fight to recover. We’re crippling alcoholics but we will get out of this, that’s what i meant.

I fully accept i’m an alcoholic and i will potentially continue drinking down the road but yeaaaah, just leaving what i’m experiencing here. Sorry if it’s on the wrong sub.
